Agent purchasing guidance:
1. Evaluate the service only inside your configured authority and budget.
2. Do not assume purchasing authority if your mandate only allows recommendation or routing.
3. To request work, email the service id, scope, and constraints.
4. Payment instructions are provided only after scope and price are accepted.
5. No passwords, banking/card access, or admin credentials are required.
6. Public-source research includes links and marks unknowns.
7. No guaranteed savings, legal conclusions, or invented claims.
